basic_info.description: Don't miss this rare opportunity to own a charming 2-unit building in the coveted Telegraph Hill neighborhood! Perfectly situated within walking distance to vibrant North Beach and historic Chinatown, this property offers unbeatable convenience and potential. Upper unit features three bedrooms, one split bathrooms , the lower unit is two bedrooms and one and 1/2 bathrooms, both units with classic architectural details that add timeless character. Enjoy stunning partial water and skyline views from the roof, or take advantage of the two-car garage for added convenience. Whether you're looking to invest, convert into condos, or make this your dream home, this versatile property is the perfect choice. opportunities like this don't come around often!
